const a=$json.authorized_action||{}, i=$json.identity||{}; const action=a.action||$json.intent; const readOnly=['promotion','pricing'].includes(action); const identityOk=readOnly ? true : ['channel_linked','order_verified','high_assurance'].includes(i.identity_level); const contractOk=a.execution_allowed===true || readOnly; return [{json:{...$json,_wf13_auth_ok:identityOk&&contractOk,_wf13_read_only:readOnly,_wf13_action:action}}];

const a=$json.authorized_action||{}, p=a.parameters||{}; const ctx=$json.promotion_context||{}; const now=Date.now(); const codes=Array.isArray(p.promo_codes)?p.promo_codes:[p.promo_code].filter(Boolean); const cart=p.cart||ctx.cart||{}; const items=Array.isArray(cart.lines)?cart.lines:[]; const total=Number(cart.subtotal||0); const customer=ctx.customer||{}; const candidates=Array.isArray(ctx.promotions)?ctx.promotions:[]; return [{json:{...$json,_wf13_eval:{codes,cart,items,total,customer,candidates,now},_wf13_parameters_valid:true}}];

const e=$json._wf13_eval; const results=[]; for(const p of e.candidates){let reasons=[]; let eligible=true; if(p.active===false) {eligible=false;reasons.push('inactive')} if(p.starts_at&&Date.parse(p.starts_at)>e.now){eligible=false;reasons.push('not_started')} if(p.ends_at&&Date.parse(p.ends_at)<e.now){eligible=false;reasons.push('expired')} if(p.min_order_value!=null&&e.total<Number(p.min_order_value)){eligible=false;reasons.push('minimum_not_met')} if(Array.isArray(p.allowed_customer_refs)&&p.allowed_customer_refs.length&&!p.allowed_customer_refs.includes(e.customer.customer_ref)){eligible=false;reasons.push('customer_not_eligible')} if(p.usage_limit_remaining!=null&&Number(p.usage_limit_remaining)<=0){eligible=false;reasons.push('usage_limit_reached')} results.push({promotion_id:p.id,code:p.code||null,eligible,reasons,discount_type:p.discount_type||null,discount_value:p.discount_value??null,priority:Number(p.priority||0),exclusive:Boolean(p.exclusive)});} return [{json:{...$json,_wf13_results:results}}];

const rs=$json._wf13_results||[]; const eligible=rs.filter(r=>r.eligible); const exclusives=eligible.filter(r=>r.exclusive); let applicable=exclusives.length?exclusives:eligible; applicable=[...applicable].sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority); const stacking=$json.promotion_context?.stacking_policy||'exclusive_by_default'; if(stacking==='one_only'&&applicable.length>1) applicable=applicable.slice(0,1); return [{json:{...$json,_wf13_applicable:applicable,_wf13_stacking_policy:stacking}}];

const applicable=$json._wf13_applicable||[]; const cart=$json._wf13_eval?.cart||{}; let discount=0; for(const p of applicable){const v=Number(p.discount_value||0); if(p.discount_type==='percentage') discount += Number(cart.subtotal||0)*v/100; else if(p.discount_type==='fixed') discount += v;} const subtotal=Number(cart.subtotal||0); const bounded=Math.max(0,Math.min(discount,subtotal)); return [{json:{...$json,_wf13_quote:{promotion_ids:applicable.map(x=>x.promotion_id),codes:applicable.map(x=>x.code).filter(Boolean),discount:bounded,subtotal,total_after_discount:Math.max(0,subtotal-bounded),currency:cart.currency||'TND'}}}];

const x=$json; const action=x._wf13_action; const live=x.promotion_context?.live_source_result; if(['cart_add','checkout_start','checkout_confirm'].includes(action) && !live) return [{json:{...x,status:'awaiting_live_promotion_check',execution_allowed:false,verification_status:'not_run'}}]; if(live && live.verified!==true) return [{json:{...x,status:'failed',execution_allowed:false,verification_status:'failed'}}]; return [{json:{...x,status:'ready',execution_allowed:false,verification_status:live?'verified':'static_only'}}];
